changesApplied.changeMade: Added GitHub CLI (gh) installation after git. Includes gpg dependency, GitHub CLI GPG key setup, apt repository configuration, gh installation, and version verification.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement for PR operations. The activity-git.ts:202-206 requires gh CLI for createPR function. Without gh CLI, autonomous PR creation fails.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk. Adds ~50MB to image size. No breaking changes to existing functionality. Enables new capability (PR creation).

changesApplied.changeMade: Extended secrets section with githubToken (empty default), gitUserName (default: 'Devbob Agent'), and gitUserEmail (default: 'devbob@metabob.local'). Added documentation comments explaining token scopes required.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement for git credentials. Provides deployment-time configuration interface for operators to supply GitHub token and git identity. Required for commit attribution and push authentication.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero risk. Only adds configuration options with safe defaults. Existing deployments continue working. New deployments must supply githubToken for git operations.
changesApplied.verificationCommand: helm template devbob helm/charts/devbob --set secrets.githubToken=test123 | grep github-token

changesApplied.changeMade: Added three new secret keys: github-token, git-user-name, git-user-email. All use base64 encoding from values.yaml inputs.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement for credential storage. Translates Helm values into Kubernetes secret data. Required by StatefulSet environment variable injection.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero risk. Template change only. Depends on values.yaml for input. Secrets are only created at deployment time.
changesApplied.verificationCommand: kubectl get secret devbob-secrets -n metabob -o jsonpath='{.data}' | jq 'keys'

changesApplied.changeMade: Added three environment variables injected from devbob-secrets: GITHUB_TOKEN (from github-token key), GIT_USER_NAME (from git-user-name key), GIT_USER_EMAIL (from git-user-email key). Inserted after ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and before METABOB_API_URL.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement for credential availability in pod environment. Makes git credentials accessible to entrypoint script and OpenCode processes. Required for git config and gh CLI authentication.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk. Environment variables only exist if secret keys are present. Backward compatible (missing keys result in empty env vars). Enables git operations when credentials supplied.
changesApplied.verificationCommand: kubectl exec -n metabob devbob-0 -- env | grep -E '(GIT|GITHUB)'

changesApplied.changeMade: Added comprehensive Step 3b: Git Configuration section between environment validation (Step 3) and self-configuration (Step 4). Includes: (1) git global config for user.name, user.email, init.defaultBranch, push.autoSetupRemote, (2) safe.directory configuration for /workspace, (3) gh CLI authentication with GITHUB_TOKEN if present, (4) verification of gh installation and auth status, (5) detailed logging of git configuration summary.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement for git configuration at container startup. Critical phase that bridges environment variables (Step 3) with git operations (activity-git.ts). Without this, git commands fail with 'user.name not set' and gh CLI cannot authenticate. This is the integration point between credentials (phases 1-3) and git operations.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium risk. Changes container startup sequence. Adds ~3-5 seconds to startup time for gh auth login. Non-fatal errors logged as warnings (degrades gracefully if GITHUB_TOKEN missing). If gh CLI not installed, warns but continues. All git config commands use '|| true' for fault tolerance.
changesApplied.verificationCommand: kubectl exec -n metabob devbob-0 -- git config --global --list

dataFlowIntegrity.phase1_to_phase2: Dockerfile installs gh CLI → Helm values provide token → Secrets template stores token → StatefulSet injects token → Entrypoint authenticates gh CLI
dataFlowIntegrity.phase2_to_phase3: Helm values define git credentials → Secrets template encodes credentials → StatefulSet injects as env vars
dataFlowIntegrity.phase3_to_phase4: StatefulSet injects GIT_USER_NAME/EMAIL/GITHUB_TOKEN → Entrypoint reads env vars → Configures git global config and gh CLI
dataFlowIntegrity.phase4_to_operations: Entrypoint configures git → activity-git.ts operations (createBranch, commit, push, createPR) succeed without errors
rippleEffects: All git operations now inherit user.name and user.email from global config
All push operations automatically create remote branches (push.autoSetupRemote=true)
gh CLI can create PRs without interactive authentication prompts
Workspace directory trusted by git (no 'dubious ownership' errors)

postEnforcement.gitConfigPresent: Expected PASS after rebuild and redeploy
postEnforcement.gitCredentialsPresent: Expected PASS after secret creation with token
postEnforcement.workspaceIsGitRepo: Requires Phase 5 (vessel initialization) - not implemented yet

remainingGaps.reason: Deferred to separate implementation. Requires activity template creation for vessel repo cloning (metabob-opencode, metabob-cli, metabob-dashboard). This phase depends on phases 1-4 being deployed and functional.

secretCreation.reason: New secret keys must be populated with actual values
steps: Generate GitHub Personal Access Token (classic) with repo, workflow, write:packages scopes
Update helm/charts/devbob/values.yaml with actual githubToken value

Or create secret manually: kubectl create secret generic devbob-secrets -n metabob --from-literal=github-token=ghp_xxx --from-literal=git-user-name='Devbob Agent' --from-literal=git-user-email=devbob@metabob.local --from-literal=anthropic-api-key=$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

statefulSetRedeploy.reason: Environment variable changes require pod recreation
statefulSetRedeploy.estimatedTime: 2-3 minutes per pod (6-9 minutes for 3 replicas)

step4.command: kubectl exec -n metabob devbob-0 -- gh auth status
